responsibility: Extends the Arm Linux EABI target configuration for FDPIC-based uClinux environments. It forces -mfdpic and PIE defaults in cc1 unless explicitly disabled, adds default assembler FDPIC flags, selects the appropriate FDPIC linker emulation by endianness, forces PIE and eager relocation for nonshared links, and adjusts startfiles to include the FDPIC relocation startup object.
